data.name: Kavita
data.gender_notes: Kavita is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit kavi, 'poet' — kavitā, 'poem'. Its root is Sanskrit kavi (कवि). A classical Sanskrit term for poetry. Kavita is a Sanskrit name meaning “Poem; poetry”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Kavita expresses “Poem; poetry”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kavita total 19, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.
